$comment: Task contracts for the three bounded model tasks (R-63, PRD §14.1). Budgets are ceilings per task run; actual money limits come from the project allowance (R-34, Q-05). Numbers are starting values, tuned from the R0 evaluation and changed only through a spec. Each task also names its output disposition and reviewing gate; per-attempt bindings are in execution.schema.json (ADR-021). Every task can also fail with stale_input or cancelled.

postconditions: every fetch_source URL came from search_sources results in this run, from operatorSourceUrls, or from links of a page fetched in this run (at most maxLinkHops such hops)
every evidence.sourceId was returned by fetch_source in this run
every excerpt is found in the fetched text and is under 25 words
claims with no supporting evidence are listed as gaps, not claims
every bound input version is still the head version when the result is stored (else stale_input)
every claimId is one of the input claims
beat kinds follow the series narrative structure (R-57)
estimated narration fits the target duration at the pinned pace
every bound input version is still the head version when the result is stored (else stale_input)
with a revisionScope, every beat or scene outside targetIds equals the previous version (else out_of_scope_change)
videoSpec passes validate_scene_spec, or every remaining error is listed under unsupportedNeeds
every scene references script segments that exist
displayed values reference demonstration results (valueRef), never typed-in numbers
every bound input version is still the head version when the result is stored (else stale_input)
with a revisionScope, every beat or scene outside targetIds equals the previous version (else out_of_scope_change)
